item.title: Hamilton-Zero: A Neural Tensor-Network Foundation Model for Ground States of Arbitrary Quadratic Qubit Hamiltonians
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Timothy Heightman, Elena Orlova, Philip Mantrov, Aleksei Ustimenko
arXiv:2608.11911v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A central promise of useful quantum advantage is the ability to compute ground states of Hamiltonian systems beyond the reach of classical simulation methods. Here we demonstrate that this problem can be effectively amortized across an arbitrary and universal set of Hamiltonians by a foundation model with sim0.5B variational parameters, trained with contemporary techniques from large language models and deep reinforcement learning. To do this, we formulate spin-1/2 quantum ground-state learning as manifold variational optimisation over centrally odd scalar functions on SU(2)^N. This replaces explicit Hilbert-space vector amplitudes with manifold functions on which the Hamiltonian acts through Lie derivatives, evaluated by custom automatic…

item.title: Optimizing Expert-Designed Crystal Graph Networks for Band-Gap Prediction with an Autonomous LLM Research Loop
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Chenmu Zhang, Boris I. Yakobson
arXiv:2606.29717v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Predicting a material's properties from its structure is a central, fast-advancing problem in computational materials science. A decade of work has produced standard public benchmarks and many published machine-learning models for the task (Dunn et al., 2020). The task's fixed metric and these baselines make it a natural setting for autonomous agent research (Karpathy, 2026). On the MatBench band-gap benchmark (>100k crystals), a general-purpose coding agent autonomously built the most accurate model trained without external pretraining, ahead of all seventeen expert-designed models reported for the task. item.title: 面向数据驱动本构建模高效采样的多样性感知批量主动学习
item.description:
📚 ScienceDirect
该工作围绕数据驱动本构模型中的样本选择效率问题展开，重点是批量模式主动学习中如何兼顾信息量与样本多样性。根据题名和期刊信息，研究可能旨在减少昂贵仿真或实验数据需求，同时提升材料本构关系机器学习建模的泛化能力。具体方法、基准体系和性能结果需查阅原文。

item.title: 用于单原子与分子推进剂低功率霍尔推力器性能预测的机器学习方法研究
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Shantanusinh Parmar, Joseph A. Moskovitz, Dan Lev, Mitchell L. R. Walker
本文针对低功率霍尔推力器在单原子与分子推进剂条件下的性能预测，建立了与推进剂类型无关的机器学习框架。模型以推力、束流电流和放电电流为预测目标，覆盖Xe、Kr、Ar、CO2和N2等推进剂，并针对真空实验数据稀疏问题设计了预处理流程，包括截断高斯重采样与蒙特卡洛增强。作者还比较了多种回归算法，并发现引入物理信息特征可进一步改善预测效果。

item.title: 基于深度学习力场的Fe-Si体系全面计算：水星核心结构研究
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Wei-Jie Li, Zi Li, Weijie Wang, Wen-shuo Liu, Cong Wang, Ping Zhang
本文结合深度学习与从头算分子动力学，构建统一计算框架以系统提取Fe-Si（Si含量低于25 at.%）体系在不同状态变量下的物性演化。作者计算了状态方程、热弹性性质、绝热线、熔化曲线与输运性质，用于约束水星核心结构模型。结果支持存在较大的固态内核，并暗示核心上部可能具有热分层；同时给出的热导率估计也为这一判断提供了依据。

item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Janus F. Niebuhr, Matthias Eschrig, Danilo Nikolić
arXiv:2608.11906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic theoretical study of the Josephson effect in junctions consisting of a d-wave altermagnet (AM) placed between two BCS superconductors (SC). In general, the SC/AM interfaces are spin-active and modeled by spin-dependent δ potentials, allowing for an arbitrary direction of the local exchange field vector. The model is formulated within the fully quantum (Gor'kov) and quasiclassical (Eilenberger) Green's function technique, applied to two distinct cases of (i) a weakly spin-polarized AM (exchange field much smaller compared to the Fermi energy) and (ii) a strongly spin-polarized AM (exchange field comparable to the Fermi energy). 👤 D. Pescia
arXiv:2608.12189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In these Lecture Notes we review some of the fundamental principles that have emerged from research on the ferromagnetism of ultrathin films consisting of 3d transition-metal overlayers. 该工作基于第一性原理，研究表面碳残留对 Nd₂Fe₁₄B 永磁体磁性能的影响。作者关注碳残留引起的局域电子结构、磁交换与磁各向异性变化，以揭示其对磁体性能的微观作用机制。该研究有助于理解制备过程中表面污染对高性能稀土永磁材料的潜在影响。
